primitives.name: Native Authority
primitives.normative: A Parallax profile MUST NOT replace or silently rewrite the authoritative native state/format of a participating system. Native authorities remain explicit.
primitives.creative_witness: Creative spec §3.3 Native authority and §7 Rollback policy.
primitives.governance_witness: Pass 11: OpenField owns evidence verification; PRCE owns approval verification; Phi-Pantheon BootstrapStatus.bootable owns native release readiness.

primitives.name: Exact Subject Identity
primitives.normative: Consequential handoffs, decisions, or custody transitions MUST bind to an exact subject state using a deterministic identity. A reference to a mutable name alone is insufficient.
primitives.creative_witness: Creative spec §3.1 actual-byte SHA-256 verification plus artifact/RenderPlan/bridge continuity.
primitives.governance_witness: Pass 11 exact OpenField review-bundle SHA-256 bound into the exact PRCE requested_action SHA-256.

primitives.name: Evidence / Truth Separation
primitives.normative: Identity, schema validity, signatures, receipts, and evidence MAY support a claim but MUST NOT be promoted into truth, authorship, rights, safety, or release authority by implication.
primitives.creative_witness: Creative spec §3.1: hash proves byte identity only, not authorship/rights/truth/safety/permission.
primitives.governance_witness: Pass 11 review bundle records cryptographicValidity=not-evaluated-by-projection and evidenceTruth=not-established.

primitives.name: Explicit Human Boundary
primitives.normative: A consequential transition that the profile reserves for a person MUST require an explicit human action/decision. Evidence or machine policy MUST NOT silently substitute for that decision.
primitives.governance_witness: Pass 11 PRCE native signed human approval decides the exact requested action.

primitives.name: Authority Phase Separation
primitives.normative: Evidence, review, decision, permission, implementation ability, execution, and receipt MUST remain distinguishable. Permission MUST NOT imply an adapter; a receipt MUST NOT imply permission.
primitives.creative_witness: Creative spec §3.2 no render/network/subprocess/auto-import authority and §3.4 receipt does not authorize.
primitives.governance_witness: Pass 11 review bundle authority=NONE; capability adapterExists=false; approval cannot manufacture Pantheon bootability.

primitives.name: Fail-Closed Transition
primitives.normative: When an exact identity, required authority, freshness rule, or native gate does not match, the affected transition MUST block rather than degrade into a warning-and-continue path.
primitives.creative_witness: Creative spec §3.1 hash mismatch MUST fail closed and §3.5 stale/equivocation rejection.
primitives.governance_witness: Pass 11 altered review bundle breaks approval binding; native Pantheon block cannot be overridden.

primitives.name: Immutable Receipt / Lineage
primitives.normative: Historical receipts, identities, and lineage MUST remain reconstructable. Rollback or later decisions MUST NOT rewrite historical hashes or retroactively reinterpret a prior receipt as authority.
primitives.creative_witness: Creative spec §3.4 Receipts and §7 Rollback policy.
primitives.governance_witness: Pass 11 preserves evidence/receipt refs and exact approval subject binding; changed subject stales approval.

nonGoals: mandatory parallax.capability.v1 packet in every profile
mandatory planRevision field in every profile

interpretation.DECIDES: explicit human authority when reserved to a human
